messages:
Evelyn Park: Heads-up — Sundial Labs dropped to ~0 inference calls today. Renewal in ~3 weeks. They were ~10k tokens/day last week. Flagging for renewal triage.
Diego Ramos: Oh no. Any churn on the champion side?
Harper Lee: Their ML lead moved to another team last Friday. Procurement is running an eval with ArgusAI (on-prem pitch). I see an internal SR: SR-10222  mentions a compliance review.
Marta Silva: Quick usage pull I ran:
```sql
SELECT day, SUM(tokens) FROM usage WHERE account='sundial' AND day >= '2026-03-10' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC;
```
Marta Silva: Result: 2026-03-20 -> 0, 2026-03-19 -> 9,800, 2026-03-18 -> 10,200.
Evelyn Park: Likely causes: new security lead pause, rekeying, or devs switching to the Argus stub. Proposed triage: 1) short IP-restricted token (48h) to re-enable tests, 2) offer 20k free tokens + 30-min SE perf tune, 3) 20-min joint security/integration call, 4) provide a simple canary rollout plan.
Diego Ramos: Agree. Also prep a tight one-pager TCO vs Argus highlighting failover & burst capacity. Procurement will ask about SLA and data residency.
Harper Lee: Uploaded SR notes and Argus demo recap to /shared/sundial/argus-demo.pdf. Also small warmup curl for their infra team:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}'
```
Marta Silva: SE config suggestion (safe defaults they can try):
```yaml
inference:
  prefix_cache: true
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  batch_window_ms: 20
```
Evelyn Park: I'll lead outreach. Diego, can you own the TCO one-pager? Harper, can you be SE on the call and run a perf profile beforehand?
Diego Ramos: On it. I'll keep the TCO <=2 slides and include a short comparative cost calc.
Harper Lee: Perf note: p95 latency in us-east over last 30 days ~130ms. Will attach the perf graph. Can also propose a canary: re-enable for 10% traffic for 24h, monitor errors and tail latency, then 100% if good.
Evelyn Park: Draft outreach (short):
"Hi Casey (Sundial),
We noticed API calls stopped after your infrastructure changes. To help unblock tests we can issue an IP-restricted 48h token and run a 30-min perf tune with our SE. Would you have 20 mins this week to walk security and infra through the steps? If tests look good we can stage a 10% canary the same day.
—Evelyn (CSM)"
Marta Silva: Nice. I'll also attach a <150-word SAML checklist for their security lead.
ticket-bot: SR-10222 linked to renewal task SD-155. Priority set to HIGH by Evelyn Park.
Diego Ramos: Legal FYI: if procurement asks for trial extension, we can offer a 60-day trial with AE approval. I'll ping AE.
Evelyn Park: OK team — outreach sent. Follow-ups: Harper to upload perf profile by EOD, Diego to finish TCO slides, Marta to prepare checklist and the IP-token request form. If Sundial doesn't re-enable within 6 days after the unblock call we escalate to AE for exec outreach. Closing interim thread; will post call notes here.
